description: Override where the app thinks it is. set_location pins it to `latitude`+`longitude`, a `query` ('lat, lon' or a Google/Apple Maps link) or a `place` name from get_location. start_route moves it along `points` ([{latitude, longitude}, ...]), a `route` (a preset: walk, run, drive, highway, tunnel, loop; or an app route id), or in a straight line `to` a place, at `speed` m/s; heading and speed follow the route. pause_route / resume_route / seek_route (`meters` or `fraction`) / set_speed control it, and stop_route ends it and stays where it got to. enter_region / exit_region move just inside or outside a monitored geofence `identifier`, which runs the app's geofencing task. conditions sets the signal quality in one step: `conditions` good (±5 m), weak (±65 m, drifting up to 50 m), no-signal or off. signal (on=false) stops updates and fails requests; services (on=false) reports location services disabled. tune sets `accuracy` and `jitter` (drift) in meters. use_real returns to the real position but keeps signal/services switches; reset ends every override. Works for expo-location (including background tasks and geofencing), @react-native-community/geolocation and react-native-geolocation-service. Permission comes from the device or the Permissions tool: a denied permission still fails. Native maps' own blue dot follows the device's real location; use sim_location for that. The override survives reload_app.

accuracy.description: tune: reported accuracy radius in meters.

conditions.description: conditions (required): good, weak, no-signal or off.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

heading.description: start_route with a preset: direction to head, degrees from north. tune: heading reported while pinned.

identifier.description: enter_region / exit_region (required): the region's identifier from get_location.

interval.description: tune: ms between updates to live watches (default 1000).

jitter.description: tune: GPS drift in meters (0 = none).

label.description: set_location: a name to show for the place.

loop.description: start_route with points: start over after the last point.

meters.description: seek_route: meters from the route's start.

on.description: signal / services (required): true = working, false = off.

persist.description: settings: keep the override across reloads.

place.description: set_location: a place name from get_location (app places and built-ins).

points.description: start_route: two or more points to travel through.

query.description: set_location: 'lat, lon' text or a Google/Apple Maps link.

route.description: start_route: a preset id (walk, run, drive, highway, tunnel, loop) or an app route id.

showChip.description: settings: show the floating location chip while overridden.

speed.description: start_route / set_speed: meters per second (1.4 walk, 13.4 city, 30 highway).

task.description: enter_region / exit_region: the geofencing task name, when two tasks share an identifier.

to.description: start_route: travel in a straight line to this place name or 'lat, lon'.

name: location_action
